We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as a reference goal for accessibility improvements.
This statement does not represent a verified certification or claim that every page currently conforms to WCAG 2.2 AA.

We aim to improve compatibility with commonly used screen readers and assistive technologies.
We aim to provide useful alternative text for informative images.

We recognize the importance of accessible forms and payment interfaces.

We aim to provide usable layouts on mobile phones and tablets.

Information about your browser or assistive technology may help us investigate.
Where an accessibility issue prevents completion of an essential shopping task, our support team can review available assistance options.
We welcome accessibility feedback and aim to improve the website experience over time.
